description: The project's current Baidu Webmaster (百度搜索资源平台) connection, plus today's push-quota usage. `today.lastRemain` is Baidu's own authoritative remaining-quota count as of the last push (null until the first push of the day) — `today.assumedDailyQuota` is a courtesy default only, never a real ceiling, since Baidu computes quota per-site dynamically and publishes no fixed number.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_baidu_connection
